svg.aria-label: SYNTAX ERROR IN 20 — repairs the title path of a scanned 1984 BASIC listing: a Kiro agent proposes patches, and the checksum printed on the page and an emulated C64 decide. Brand frame on an authored 2026 listing (the error this project is named after), not a Kiro run: in a candle-lit crypt, line 20 reads PR1NT (a planted OCR confusable), its sum 115 misses the printed :rem 139 and the C64 prints ?SYNTAX ERROR IN 20; a test harness types the patch 1 → I, the sum becomes 139 = 139 and the title prints: it lives. Screens measured on c64-ready.
svg.text: 76–84% of the lines free OCR emitted fail the page's own checksum
